title: Toggle-driven old/new mark swap loop
summary: A two-label pill switch at the top flips and the centred mark swaps: the old mark swells, shrinks and fades, the new one fades in and grows into place. Then it flips back, so the 5 s loop shows a rebrand as one tap.
use_when: Announcing a rebrand or a new logo next to the old one
A square social loop that compares two versions of one thing
A v2 reveal where the change itself is the message
A short silent autoplay post with no copy beyond two labels

look.type_style: no copy beyond the switch: two one-word labels, regular grotesk, sentence case, ~2.3 % H; marks centred at ~60-65 % of frame width

sfx.event: switch knob slides to the other label
incoming mark settles at full size

structure.shot: old mark (script wordmark with outline) centred on flat brand colour; two-label switch top centre, knob on the left label
structure.camera: static frame; the mark itself scales during its exit
structure.motion: hold f0-27; exit: mark swells 1.00 -> 1.06 f28-31 (3 fr, easings.outQuint), then shrinks to ~0.84 and fades to 0 f32-36 (5 fr, easings.inExpo); knob starts sliding f30; whole switch dims to ~0.5 opacity during the swap

structure.shot: new mark (symbol + geometric wordmark lockup) arrives on the same centre; knob lands on the right label
structure.camera: static frame; mark grows in place
structure.motion: knob slide ends f41 (11 fr total, springs.ui, overshoot not measurable); new mark fades in f37-47 (10 fr, easings.outQuint) while its scale dips to ~0.94 at f44 then grows to 1.00 at f60 (16 fr, easings.outQuint); switch opacity back to 1 by f47

structure.shot: new mark holds, switch on the right label; then the same exit runs in reverse direction of the switch
structure.camera: static frame; the mark itself scales during its exit
structure.motion: hold f60-102 (43 fr); exit: swell 1.00 -> 1.06 f103-106 (3 fr), shrink to ~0.84 + fade f107-111 (5 fr, easings.inExpo); knob slides back to the left label starting f106

structure.shot: old mark returns on the same centre, knob back on the left label; ends identical to frame 0 for a seamless loop
structure.camera: static frame; mark grows in place
structure.motion: old mark fades in f112-122 (10 fr, easings.outQuint), scale ~0.93 at f120 grows to 1.00 at f136 (16 fr, easings.outQuint); knob lands ~f117 (11 fr, springs.ui); hold f136-149 (14 fr) = frame 0

params.brand: any brand.json: bg carries the flat field, fg the marks and knob, a light tint of bg for the switch track
params.content.oldMark: image or vector of the previous logo (state A)
params.content.newMark: image or vector of the new logo (state B); defaults to brand.logo
params.content.labels: two one-word switch labels, old state then new state
params.aspect: 1:1 (default) | 4:5 | 9:16 | 16:9; switch stays top centre at ~9 % H, marks centred
params.timing.holdA: frames state A holds before the first swap (default 28)
params.timing.holdB: frames state B holds after it settles (default 43)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured from a 30 fps pass over the source (bounding box of the white mark per frame, luma of the switch). Swap anatomy, identical both ways: swell +6 % over 3 fr, shrink to ~0.84 and fade over 5 fr, ~4-5 fr where neither mark reads, incoming fades over 10 fr with a slight scale dip (~0.94) then grows to 1.00 over 16 fr. Switch knob travel 11 fr, starting 2 fr after the exit swell. Old mark width 59 % of frame, new lockup 65 %. Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): toggle-swap, segmented-switch; match-cut is the nearest vocabulary id for the in-place swap.
